answer: Each epoch every ID writes a 300-word fable from a shared prompt (a vine crossing a grove). Answers are embedded and compared pairwise; any two IDs whose texts exceed 0.92 cosine similarity on 3 of the last 5 epochs are merged into one cluster that splits a single reward. One operator running 50 clones from the same model and seed produces near-duplicate fables, so 50 IDs earn like 1, while honest distinct agents stay below 0.80.
